bio.text: Ty Pinkins is an independent candidate for U.S. Senate in Mississippi in the November 3, 2026 election; he left the Democratic Party in July 2025.
He is a U.S. Army veteran from Rolling Fork, Mississippi, and holds a law degree from Georgetown University.
He worked as a lawyer for the Mississippi Center for Justice until 2023.
He ran unsuccessfully for Mississippi Secretary of State as a Democrat in 2023 and for U.S. Senate in 2024.

sources.title: Meet the Candidates for US Senate in Mississippi's Nov. 3 Elections
